sentences.en: The turnover at my company is really speeding up lately.
sentences.zh: 我们公司的营业额最近真的在加速增长。

sentences.en: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
sentences.zh: 去年，这家公司实现了营业额的显著增长。

sentences.en: The turnover on the Tokyo stock Exchange swelled to the year's record.
sentences.zh: 东京证券交易所的成交量创下了年度新高。

senses.zh: 营业额，成交量；人员更替，流动率；翻转；失误（尤指体育比赛中）；营业额
